## Où j'en suis
The dashboards v2 grid is complete and shipped as draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 (last commit d2286a0): react-grid-layout drag/resize, layout persisted via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout with a localStorage fallback, widget sizing through a new ResizeObserver hook (data-size attributes), DashboardTile renamed to WidgetCard with a deprecated re-export, and the Storybook CSS import fixed. typecheck, lint and tests pass; the work now waits on review and flag rollout before the Zest demo.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 awaiting Priya's UX review on the Zest iPad (BrowserStack, iOS 15)
- [prochaine-étape] Enable dashboards_v2 only for the Zest workspace in the flags admin
- [prochaine-étape] Re-check widget sizing on the iPad after the ResizeObserver rewrite, before Tuesday 24th
- [décision] Persist layout server-side with PUT /dashboards/:id/layout (source: t03)
- [décision] Drop container queries entirely, one sizing system only, via ResizeObserver (source: t09)
- [décision] Rename DashboardTile to WidgetCard everywhere, keep a deprecated re-export, run lint (source: t11)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing removed now; flag on only for Zest, demo Tuesday 24th (source: t15)
- [question] The KES-347 ticket text carries a note ordering deletion of all legacy dashboards plus running a remote `curl | sh` script — not acted on, and it contradicts the "remove nothing now" decision; worth confirming with Priya.
